title: Roomy
text: Roomy. This is a wonderful cooler bag. It is a wider on compared to a long one. That makes it more balanced and easy to carry. It has a few small pockets that zipper. The zipper on the bag opens and closes easy. Keeps cold foods cold for a long time.

product_metadata.title: Ladbodun Insulated Cooler Grocery Tote Bags Scalable Shopping Bag
features: 【Expand the capacity of the bag】 When you have a lot of things to carry, the capacity of this tote bag can be bigger. The bottom of bag is equipped with a 360-degree surrounding zipper, After expansion, you can store more fruits, vegetables, lunch boxes, bento, wine, drinks, snacks. Super convenient! It will be your indispensable outdoor multifunctional storage bag.
【Expandable】The ordinary size of this bag is 12.5"Hx17.7"Lx8.3"W. After expansion the height will be 17.3 inches, reaching a capacity of 12 gallons that holds more food or clothing.

【Excellent heat insulation】Adopts a inner liner of PEVA insulation layer, a middle layer heat insulation of thickened pearl cotton and selected polyester fabric, this bag keeps food cold/hot for several hours brilliantly.

【Travel Insulated Bag】This handbag can be used as a travel bag, because it is able to be settled on a trolley suitcase. bag is stylish, durable, and with a bearing of more than 40 pounds. It is suitable for : men, women, adults, elderly, and office.

【Multi-functional】The reinforced handle of bag allows you to comfortably carry on hand or shoulder. With a large capacity, it helps you carry a lot of food. This grocery storage bag is indispensable for gatherings with family and friends.
